## Source name

## City

SF Bay Area, or the city this source covers.

## URL

The calendar, feed, or organizer page — or the X/Twitter handle.

## Kind

One of: `luma_calendar`, `rss_feed`, `event_digest`, `organizer_site`, `indexed_source`, `x_account`
(see `packages/discovery/src/source-registry.ts` for what each kind means).

## Why it's high-signal

What makes this a good source for small, curated founder/operator events? For example:
approval-required or invite-only rooms, named hosts, consistently posts direct RSVP links, strong
founder/operator/investor density.

## Example events

Link 2-3 recent or upcoming events from this source that fit the kind of room the scout looks for.
